newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices cut by old crop flows.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices cut by old crop flows.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell to 1,119/1,120 rupees on Tuesday from 1,124/1,125 rupees on old crop inflows and lower export enquiry, dealers said.
"New crop arrivals are yet to pickup but there is constant supply of old season crops," one dealer said.
Export deals for Indian castoroil traded at $708 per tonne last week but foreign buyers were now offering $695/700.

Groundnut oil slid to 410/412 rupees per 10 kg on increased new crop arrivals and sluggish physical support. Rajkot spot oil however gained to 570 rupees per 15 kg on eased pressure of offerings by millers and farmers at the lower levels.
